title: Sculpted Chest
description: Upper body strength with push and pull: varied push-ups and back reinforcement in 2 blocks

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Moderate high knees
exercises.instructions: Knees to chest at a moderate pace

exercises.name: Scapular push-ups
exercises.instructions: In a plank, squeeze and spread the shoulder blades without bending elbows

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.instructions: On all fours, alternate cat and cow, breathe

exercises.name: Push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hands shoulder-width apart, body braced, lower chest to the floor

exercises.name: Chair dips
exercises.instructions: Hands on the edge, elbows pointing back, lower to 90 degrees

exercises.name: Pike push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hips high in inverted V, lower head between hands

exercises.name: Incline push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hands on an elevated surface, easier variation

exercises.name: Superman
exercises.instructions: Lying face down, lift arms and legs simultaneously, hold 2s

exercises.name: Prone Y raises
exercises.instructions: Lying face down, arms in Y position, lift and hold 2s

exercises.name: Floor face pulls
exercises.instructions: Lying face down, elbows at 90 degrees, pull elbows back

exercises.name: Chest stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm against a wall at 90 degrees, rotate the body

exercises.name: Triceps stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm behind the head, pull elbow with the other hand

exercises.name: Scorpion stretch
exercises.instructions: Lying face down, bring foot toward opposite hand while rotating

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
